description: This file defines the OnboardingPrefs class that manages persistent onboarding-related user preferences using Android’s SharedPreferences API. It provides methods to get and set preferences such as completion status, goals, preferred duration, and analytics opt-in, all stored within a centralized preferences file.

classes.name: OnboardingPrefs
classes.description: A helper class to persist onboarding preferences such as completion status, goals, duration, and analytics opt-in using Android's SharedPreferences.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Returns whether onboarding has been completed.

methods.name: getGoals
methods.description: Retrieves the user's goals as a set of strings.

methods.name: getPreferredDuration
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred duration in minutes.

methods.name: getAnalyticsOptIn
methods.description: Checks if the user has opted in for analytics.

methods.name: setAnalyticsOptIn
methods.description: Sets the user's analytics opt-in preference.
